normative_extracts.quote: Perform PerformPromiseThen(promise, onFulfilled, onRejected) and suspend the running execution context.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: An async function runs synchronously until await, suspends its execution context into a heap generator-like frame, and schedules resumption as a microtask.

production_failures.symptom: Page load latency doubles due to sequential network waterfalls
production_failures.root_cause: Using await inside a for..of loop serializes independent fetch() calls instead of dispatching them concurrently.
production_failures.mitigation: Dispatch independent promises together with Promise.all() or Promise.allSettled().

production_failures.symptom: UnhandledRejection crashes Node/worker or leaks silent failures in browser
production_failures.root_cause: Creating a rejected promise without attaching .catch() before the end of the current microtask turn triggers unhandledrejection.
production_failures.mitigation: Attach rejection handlers synchronously or await every spawned promise within try/catch.
